note: Text is copied from the owner's scans. 'effects' will be filled in as the engine is written. Glyphs: ARCANE, DARK, ELEMENTAL, ILLUSION, PRIMAL.

cards.name: Thal Foon's
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to each foe who already acted this round.

cards.name: Dr. Rooty Bark's
cards.text: You heal 3 HP. Each foe rolls a die. Each foe who rolls a 6 heals 3 HP.

cards.name: Rose Bottom's
cards.text: Heal 1 HP for each different glyph in your spell.

cards.name: Sphinxion's
cards.text: Choose and steal a Treasure belonging to any foe.

cards.name: Pam and Hecuba's
cards.text: Your Delivery targets each foe instead.

cards.name: King Oberon's
cards.text: Heal 2 HP.

cards.name: The Death Fairy's
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to any foe. If that foe dies, repeat this effect.

cards.name: Sir Lootzor's
cards.text: You gain a Treasure. Each foe rolls a die. Each foe that rolls a 6 gains a Treasure.

cards.name: Ben Voodoo's
cards.text: Each foe rolls a die and takes that much damage. Destroy one of your Treasures if you have any.

cards.name: Scorchia's
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to your strongest foe.

cards.name: Wyrmtor's
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to each foe for each different glyph in your spell.

cards.name: Professor Presto's
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to a random foe. If you played a Wild Magic card as part of your spell, gain a Treasure.

cards.name: Magma Gog's
cards.text: Choose one: Deal 3 damage to the foe on your left OR deal 1 damage to each foe.

cards.name: Bleemax Brainiac's
cards.text: Reveal the top two cards of the Main Deck. Each one with a glyph that matches a glyph in your spell is added to your spell. Discard the rest.

cards.name: Beard'o Blasty's
cards.text: This card copies the text of the Delivery of your spell.

cards.name: Pew and Pew's
cards.text: Reveal the top four cards of the Main Deck. Add any revealed Source cards to your spell and discard the rest.

cards.name: Muzzlesnap's
cards.text: Add a die to each of your Power Rolls this round.

cards.name: Old Scratch's
cards.text: Roll a die. If you roll 1-3, you suffer that much damage. If you roll 4-6, you heal that many HP.

cards.name: Walker Time Ranger's
cards.scanNote: scanned in a different orientation from the other cards
cards.text: Each player rolls a die. Add 1 to your roll for each different glyph in your spell. Deal 3 damage to the lowest roller(s).

cards.name: Midnight Merlin's
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to your strongest foe for each living Wizard. Then draw a Dead Wizard card.
